title: Automation
systemHint: Default rule: replaced a hardcoded message; it can be disabled but not deleted

deleteConfirm.title: Delete rule?
deleteConfirm.message: Rule “{{name}}” will stop running. Its run log is kept.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.desc: Create a rule: document event → conditions → actions

messageKindHint: Service messages skip clients who opted out of messages; marketing ones reach only clients with marketing consent

skipReasons.NO_CONTACT: the recipient has no contact for any channel
skipReasons.NO_SERVICE_MESSAGES: the client opted out of service messages
skipReasons.NO_MARKETING_CONSENT: no marketing consent from the client
skipReasons.NO_CHANNEL: no channel is configured for the branch
skipReasons.TELEGRAM_BOT_NOT_CONNECTED: the Telegram bot is not connected in settings
skipReasons.TASK_EXISTS: such an open task already exists
skipReasons.DOCUMENT_DELETED: the document was deleted before sending
skipReasons.PAYMENT_REVERSED: the payment was reversed before sending
skipReasons.DOCUMENT_CANCELLED: the document was cancelled before sending

card.name: Rule name
card.namePlaceholder: E.g. “Work order in progress — SMS to client”
card.minAmountHint: In the organisation base currency; a document in another currency is compared by its base amount
card.conditionsHint: All conditions must hold at once. An empty condition does not restrict.
card.noConditions: This document and event have no extra conditions — the rule fires on the event.
card.clientMessageUnavailable: This document has no client — a client message is unavailable
card.taskOnTaskUnavailable: A rule on a task event does not create tasks
card.channelsBranchHint: All configured branch channels in the priority you set; the client’s preferred channel goes first when available
card.channelsCustomHint: Only these channels, in this order: not delivered — the next one. The client’s preferred channel is ignored here
card.subject: Subject (for email)
card.responsibleHint: work order — work assignees; task — assignee; others — the document author
card.notifyInitiator: Also notify whoever changed the document
card.notifyInitiatorHint: No by default: an employee is not notified about their own action
card.fallbackNone: None — do not create the task
card.fallbackHint: If there is no responsible person, or they are dismissed or on leave
card.saveFirst: Save the rule first to send a test
card.invalid: Check the fields marked in red

template.unknown: Unknown variables: {{vars}} — “{{document}}” has none of them
template.fragmentError: Optional fragment [[…]] is not closed or is nested in another
template.fragmentHint: [[…]] is an optional fragment: it disappears entirely if any variable inside is empty. E.g. {{example}}
template.previewPhoneHint: The sample organisation phone is empty — so you can see how a [[…]] fragment disappears

test.title: Send test
test.hint: The rule’s messages go to your own phone / email / Telegram with the chosen document’s data — without consent and quiet-hours checks. No tasks or in-app notifications are created.
test.resultEmpty: The rule has no messages to test
test.checkJournal: Delivery status is in the message log (marked “test”)

blocks.title: Event → conditions → actions

items.text: a document was created or its status changed — by any path: a button, a payment, an automatic transition
branch, status “from” and “to”, repair type, priority, amount from X — all must hold at once
message the client, notify employees (bell and / or Telegram bot, Viber, SMS), create a task

items: One document event runs a rule once; a failed action does not cancel the others or the document change.

blocks.title: Client message channels

items.text: all configured branch channels in the priority you set in “Settings → Notifications”; the client’s preferred channel goes first when available
only the chosen channels in the chosen order; not delivered — the next one

items: The Telegram bot reaches only a client who subscribed via the link or QR from their card.

items.text: always sent, except to clients marked “no service messages”
only to clients with marketing consent
a client message created at night waits until quiet hours end (set in “Notifications”); employee notifications are not restricted

blocks.title: Log
items: Every run and message is in the log with the skip reason. A test is sent to yourself, with the chosen document’s data.

telegram.title: Telegram bot
telegram.botNotConnected: The bot is not connected — connect it in “Settings → Notifications”
telegram.unsubscribeConfirm: The bot will stop sending messages to this chat. You can subscribe again with a new link.
telegram.linkHint: Open the link or scan the QR with your phone and press “Start” in the bot.
telegram.selfHint: Get notifications about tasks and documents in Telegram
